claire_cs: Quick sync for Aegis Labs private cutover. Current showstoppers after today's run: audit ingestion failing intermittently, KMS alias mismatch, and a missing sts:AssumeRole condition. Can infra/security confirm blockers and ETA?
dmitri_net: audit-forwarder is dropping connections from our forwarder IPs. Their firewall only allows a small outbound list; asked them to open the SIEM CIDRs we provided. Waiting on their ticket.
anita_kms: KMS check  their CMK alias is 'aegis-prod-key' but our runtime expects 'redwood/aegis-runtime'. Also the key policy doesn't include kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext for the redwood-runtime role.
oscar_sec: trust policy issue  cross-account role currently lacks ExternalId condition and has sessionDuration >1h. We require ExternalId and <=3600s to meet compliance audit.
claire_cs: action log: 1) Aegis to map alias and update key policy, 2) Customer to allow SIEM egress CIDRs, 3) Aegis to create trust with ExternalId and <=1h, 4) infra to re-run targeted smoke for audit-forwarding and KMS decrypt. I'll track renewal risk if any item slips >72h.
lucy_aegis: we can do alias remap and policy update tonight. ExternalId value is 'aegis-ext-77' and we'll set sessionDuration to 3600s. Firewall change is ticketed, ETA 8h.
danita_kms: (typo correction) anita_kms: after alias mapping please tag the key with 'redwood:env=priv' and avoid rotating within the next 48h. If rotation must happen, create fallback alias 'redwood/aegis-fallback'.
dmitri_net: deploy-bot: please queue a focused smoke for audit-forwarding + kms-decrypt once infra confirms alias mapped and firewall change applied.
deploy-bot: queued job 99771 awaiting trigger 'infra:green'.
claire_cs: renewal note from Marco: marco_am flagged that if cutover remains blocked >3 business days this becomes a renewal risk and AM will request an executive check-in. Marked as conditional risk.
aritical: (system) placeholder
deploy-bot: job 99771 triggered by infra; running now.
deploy-bot: job 99771 complete  audit-forwarding OK, kms-decrypt OK on all instances. One minor log timestamp skew noted (offset 2s) but not blocking.
claire_cs: great news  with audit + KMS green and trust policy fixed, we set onboarding status to 'ready-for-cutover'. I'll clear the conditional renewal flag and publish the cutover checklist in Confluence. Thanks team. :tada:
